label: a rate-limited bio endpoint (UniProt-like)
description: sparql.uniprot.org returns 429 with Retry-After: 10 after 30–35 requests within one second (measured in 2026; the limit is not published). It has a 45-minute timeout and no practical row limit.

basedOn.source: Did LLMs kill SPARQL federation? (measurement of sparql.uniprot.org)
